Res.Caption: Fumigation Certificate
Res.FullDescription: Do the goods require a fumigation certificate?

Res.Caption: Goods Description
Res.FullDescription: Description of the goods in the selected container. Plain language description of the nature of a goods item sufficient to identify it for customs purposes. For example, computer is acceptable, but electronic or various is not acceptable. In addition, this description should not contain any reference to the quantity or packaging of the goods.

Res.Caption: Tariff Number
Res.FullDescription: The Tariff Number (HS Code) that will be transmitted.

Res.Caption: Materials Hazardous in Bulk
Res.FullDescription: Tick this box where the commodity consists of materials which may possess chemical hazards when transported in bulk other than materials classified as dangerous in the International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code (IMDG Code).

Res.Caption: Marks And Numbers
Res.FullDescription: Shipping Marks and Numbers related to the selected container.

Res.Caption: Net Weight
Res.FullDescription: Net weight of goods in selected container (in cubic meters)

Res.Caption: Package Count
Res.FullDescription: Quantity of packages being shipped in current container. Units must be a valid ACROSS package type code.

Res.Caption: Package Type
Res.FullDescription: Quantity of packages being shipped in current container

Res.Caption: Volume
Res.FullDescription: Volume of goods in selected container (in specified units). Volume (cubic) of goods including packing but excluding the carrier’s equipment.

Res.Caption: Gross Weight
Res.FullDescription: Gross weight of goods in selected container. Weight of goods at the item level including packing but excluding the carrier’s equipment.

Res.Caption: Weight UQ
Res.FullDescription: Net weight of goods in selected container
